criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: axe label (critical) on Default, Checked and Disabled: with no label prop the checkbox has no name, and the component takes no aria-label
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): accept an aria-label for toggles without visible text.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on the labelled stories

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: computed: the off track is #CBCBCB on white, 1.62:1; the on track #04884C is 4.5:1
criteria.note: The off state is the one that fails. Heal (a11y): a darker off track or a 3:1 border.

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab focuses the switch, Space calls onChange

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run and screenshot: 2px #000 outline with a white ring round the track when the hidden checkbox has focus

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: nothing in the component covers the focused switch

criteria.name: Target size (minimum)
criteria.evidence: measured: the track (inside the label) is 47x29; the input itself is visually hidden

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: axe: no name without a label (see 1.3.1); role is checkbox, state follows checked
criteria.note: A switch role would match the look; checkbox is acceptable once it has a name.
